items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: He was my idol when I was a kid... I had a lot of stuff that Gene Krupa played, memorized

ctx.x: Oh sure. I had a lot of stuff that Gene Krupa played, memorized, you know and that kind of stuff. He was my idol when I was a kid. So I would play some of that stuff, I said well everybody would love this. And some guys said, “you know everybody doesn’t play like Gene Krupa, Sonny.” © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
Uh huh. Didn’t you win a Gene Krupa contest?
